interpretation: Public document collections and labeled datasets, rather than OCR software packages.
recommendation: Use fresh issuer archives plus Companies House for sponsor-like documents; use FinTabNet.c for structure-scoring checks and DocLayNet for layout checks.

collections.name: Companies House filing histories
collections.use: Best match for real scanned UK accounts; full filings, no cell ground truth.
collections.access: Public account PDFs from filing-history links. API is optional. Store stable filing URL rather than expiring redirected download URL.
collections.caution: Not every filing is scanned; inspect page text/image content. The separate bulk accounts product is XBRL, not a scan collection.

collections.name: Nestlé investor publications and presentations
collections.use: Strong match for sponsor slides: infographic KPIs, tables, multiple units and hierarchical headers.
collections.access: Public PDF links; a FY2025 presentation was downloaded and visually checked.
collections.caution: No independent cell labels. Treat document years from one issuer as one split group.

collections.name: Unilever results archive
collections.use: Financial releases and presentations with parallel business/period groups.
collections.access: Public PDF links; FY2025 full announcement downloaded and visually checked.
collections.caution: No cell ground truth; follow issuer links for complete original reports.

collections.name: AnnualReports.com
collections.use: Broader issuer/industry coverage for designed annual reports.
collections.access: Public browsing by issuer, exchange and industry; directory verified, no sample downloaded here.
collections.caution: Some reports are standardized filings. Prefer illustrated reports matching sponsor layouts; record original issuer and rights.

collections.name: FinTabNet.c
collections.use: Financial table structures and corrected oversegmentation; useful for testing row/column scoring.
collections.access: Author-hosted archives: structure 3.17 GB; PDF annotations 255 MB. File listing verified; not downloaded.
collections.caution: Annotations are automatically corrected and some cases removed. This is not evidence of real scan quality or a fresh model holdout; inspect sample labels and training overlap.

collections.name: FinTabNet OTSL
collections.use: Financial table images with cell content, HTML and OTSL structure; useful for merged-cell evaluation.
collections.access: Public Parquet splits and live sample viewer verified; not downloaded.
collections.license_label: Other; consult dataset card and original FinTabNet terms.
collections.caution: Shares the original FinTabNet data. Do not count it as an independent corpus alongside FinTabNet.c.

collections.name: DocLayNet financial_reports subset
collections.use: Human-annotated table/layout boxes to measure missed tables and crop completeness.
collections.access: Core 80,863 pages, 28 GiB; PDF/text extras 7.5 GiB. Filter doc_category=financial_reports. Documentation verified; not downloaded.
collections.caution: Layout labels are not cell/value ground truth. PNG rendering is not proof of a real scanned origin. Full dataset spans six document categories.

rules: Count complete distinct documents, not table crops.
Group all reports and years from one issuer into the same split.
Tag borderless tables, wrapped labels, grouped headers, detail/total columns and multi-table crops.
Classify scanned/born-digital per page; label mixed documents explicitly.
Freeze test issuers before model comparisons; the four inspected source probes belong to development.
Keep official PDF URLs, retrieval dates, hashes and page-level provenance.
Public benchmarks remain separate because model training overlap may be unknown.

prior_to_expansion: Resolve the three incomplete sponsor crops and rerun changed inputs consistently across all engines.
Use source-reviewed row/column/unit associations instead of numeric inventories.
Compare whole-table versus numeric/cell confidence on the same resolved cohort.
